notes.title: Uncover the Hidden World of Ghost Shadow
notes.notes:
Welcome to the Second Reality of my game #GhostShadow 👹
This is the second reality of Ghost Shadow - the universe of Jason's dreams. 
Except for core gameplay, Jason finds himself in a parallel universe, where he also has to pass his own way. Here we see its beginning.
---
Voiceover by @PaulMoranVO  - our main voice of Papacubec Games! 🔥

Enjoy watching! The best support - likes, subs, comments on YT, Twitter, FB.
Thank you! 🙏

notes.title: The 2nd level development started!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42805821/87202dc37e0f6d8ba97109a4d28437c5888ae55b.png[/img]

Hello there, hi my Cubecmans!
Publishers and investors still think that I'm not able to complete Ghost Shadow, but I definitely can do it!
I love it, it's like my child.
Of course, without investments, I should work on other projects. 
It slows down Ghost Shadow development so much!
Although I've moved GS to Unreal Engine 5.1 and fixed all bugs with it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42805821/0aa37692b76cc41b62bf1c2f1a05b5f5b11477bf.png[/img]
 
I've created a new level, it is so crazy, psychedelic, in cyberpunk style - all very different from the 1st level.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42805821/f93a50f2fd0be995268198273c1ca694ad41671e.png[/img]

Using my favorite Metahuman I've created Oldman - the new character of the game. 
(I haven’t thought of a name yet, if you have any ideas, please suggest!).
Paul Moran (our main voice of all games) - called him "old western guy" 😁

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42805821/bcf469312a73465227943df927c452a0e4c51808.png[/img]

And he is an epic and crazy guy 😁
He will crush and destruct all around him! 
I use the Chaos Destruction system VFX of UE5 - looks amazing! 💪

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42805821/48190d5c24c670bc63581a332193043f45cd0e91.png[/img]

Actually, I want to record a new gameplay trailer with him. 
Subscribe to YT channel to stay tuned!
https://www.youtube.com/@papacubec

I very much appreciate it if you would be able to support me with YT subs, Steam wishlists, and your honest feedback (on Youtube or Steam).

Thank you!🙏

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42805821/94b20ad8c6d6750fce6b4f5cf2f08634240757db.png[/img]

notes.title: Steam Next Fest
notes.notes:
Attention!
6-13 February 2023  NEXT FEST on Steam!

Welcome to play and share with my game Ghost Shadow.

You are an invincible cyborg, using frightening combo attacks from your skills and a huge arsenal of weapons, collect all the artifacts, solve the riddles of your erased memory and find a way out of the ghostly trap, from the shadow of your mind.

Ghost Shadow is Single-player FPS with bright top AAA graphics, upgrade systems in steampunk style with psychedelic mechanics, puzzles, and horror elements.


If you want to make a live broadcast of the game - let me know:
papacubec@gmail.com

Enjoy!
